segments.text: Why I build it? I usually have far more ideas than videos. I write notes, sometimes even
a full script. Then I plan a video to go with the script and this is when it usually stops.
Recording, drawing, editing, publishing, I never have enough time. Another month gone
and nothing shipped. So the question became, what if the board could draw itself and the
model could help me do it? What if I can have my dedicated video creation assistant?
